title: KV260 first boot with the IYAKKI boot loader

clauses.text: the board's U-Boot finds no extlinux.conf and starts EFI/BOOT/BOOTAA64.EFI

steps.do: Write iyakki-kv260-loader.img with kv260-write-sd.sh, connect the serial console (115200 8N1) and power on.
steps.expect: U-Boot prints that it found efi/boot/bootaa64.efi (not extlinux.conf) and starts it.

clauses.text: the loader reads boot.cfg and starts the kernel

steps.do: Read the serial text after the U-Boot lines.
steps.expect: Lines boot: loader started, config: /boot.cfg read, state: tree=current tries_left=8, start: iyakki kernel=/Image, then Linux version.

clauses.text: the system comes up as on the baseline card

steps.do: Check Ethernet, the DisplayPort shell and a USB keyboard as in the baseline guide.
steps.expect: Each works as on the baseline card.

clauses.text: the boot-tries counter and the system's confirmation

steps.do: Restart three times and read the tries_left lines.
steps.expect: Either tries_left is refilled after each good start (the confirmation works through U-Boot) or it falls by one each time (it does not: report it).
